scope: source-level implementation and regression evidence for artifact resumable upload sessions

implementation.identity: OIDC subject plus required tenant claim; tenant and owner keys persisted as SHA-256 pseudonyms
implementation.checkpoint: private staged object per part; exact Content-Range, declared byte count and SHA-256 are checked on write and rechecked while streaming completion
implementation.quota: atomic per-tenant reserved-byte and active-session accounting with terminal release
implementation.retry: dependency failure retains durable parts and quota in RETRYABLE state
implementation.limits: configurable maximum package bytes, part bytes, tenant reserved bytes and session TTL
